For every step from 30 through 40, gamma_H must be true at that step or within the next 5 steps.

gamma_S is true throughout steps 30 to 45; gamma_T is true at some step from 30 to 32 and, for each step from 30 to 35, is true at that step or within 5 steps after it; gamma_H is true at some step from 30 to 32 and, for each step from 30 to 40, is true at that step or within 5 steps after it.

At least one of the following must hold. First, for every step from step 0 through step 16, mu_1 must hold at some step no earlier than 2 and no later than 10 steps after that step. Second, there must be a step from step 0 through step 14 such that mu_2 holds at every step from that step through 10 steps later, and there must also be a step from step 0 through step 14 such that mu_3 holds at some step no earlier than 5 and no later than 10 steps after that step.

Satisfied if either mu_1 holds at some step 2 to 10 steps after each step from 0 through 16, or both mu_2 holds at every step from some step between 0 and 14 to 10 steps after that step and mu_3 holds at some step 5 to 10 steps after some step between 0 and 14.

At some step from step 10 to step 15, there must be a second step from that first step through 5 steps later such that, for every step from that second step through 10 steps later, there is a third step from that step through 5 steps later at which speed is less than 110.
Between steps 10 and 15, pick a step s; pick a step t from s through s+5; for each step u from t through t+10, speed must be less than 110 at some step from u through u+5.
At least one step from step 10 to step 30 after the start must have the absolute value of the sum of y and 5 greater than -1.3.
At one step between steps 10 and 30, the absolute value of y + 5 is greater than -1.3.

For every step from step 0 through step 130, if S_tilde is true at that step, then T_tilde_1 is true at some step from 30 to 40 steps after that step; if T_tilde_1 is true at that step, then T_tilde_2 is true at some step from 30 to 40 steps after that step; and if T_tilde_2 is true at that step, then T_tilde_1 is true at some step from 30 to 40 steps after that step. There is a step from step 170 through step 180 such that G_tilde is true at every step from that step through 30 steps after that step. At every step from step 0 through step 200, O_tilde_1 is false and O_tilde_2 is false.

From step 0 through step 130, if S_tilde is true at a step, T_tilde_1 must be true at some step from 30 to 40 steps later; if T_tilde_1 is true at a step, T_tilde_2 must be true at some step from 30 to 40 steps later; and if T_tilde_2 is true at a step, T_tilde_1 must be true at some step from 30 to 40 steps later. At some step from step 170 through step 180, G_tilde must be true at every step through 30 steps later. From step 0 through step 200, O_tilde_1 and O_tilde_2 must both be false.
At least one of the following must hold: Reg_i_1_j_1 is true at some step within 20 steps, or Reg_i_2_j_2 is true at some step within 20 steps.
Either Reg_i_1_j_1 or Reg_i_2_j_2 is true at some step within 20 steps.
mu_k_bd must be true at every time step.
mu_k_bd always holds.
At each step from step 0 to step 30, both varphi_1 and varphi_2 must be true.
During steps 0 to 30, varphi_1 and varphi_2 are true at all times.
There must be a step s between steps t_1 and t_2 such that mu is true at every step from s + t_3 to s + t_4.
At some step between steps t_1 and t_2, mu must be true at every step from that step + t_3 to that step + t_4.
At the start, x_2 is at least 1, and at some step within 4 steps, x_2 is at most -1.
x_2 must be at least 1 at step 0 and at most -1 at some step within 4 steps.

gamma_S must hold at every step from step 0 to step 15. For every step from step 0 to step 10, gamma_T must hold at some step from that step to 5 steps after it. In addition, gamma_T must hold at some step from step 12 to step 15.
gamma_S holds at all steps 0 to 15; at each step 0 to 10, gamma_T holds within 5 steps of that step; and gamma_T holds at some step from 12 to 15.
At some step from step l to step u, both y and b_i_h are true, and x is true at every step from the start through that step.
x holds at every step from the start through a step between l and u where y and b_i_h hold.
At some step from c_1 on, where c_1 is some fixed number of steps, psi is true; phi is true at every step from the start through that step.
phi holds from the start up to and including some step from c_1 on, and psi holds at that step, where c_1 is some fixed number of steps.
There must be a step from the start through step 5 at which x is at least 10 and at most 11, and there must be a step from step 1 through step 6 at which x is at least 4 and at most 5.
x must be at least 10 and at most 11 at some step within 5 steps, and at least 4 and at most 5 at some step between steps 1 and 6.
At every step from step 0 through step 70, y_5 - y_4 must be greater than 12 at some step from that step to 30 steps after it.
Every step from step 0 to step 70 has a step from that step to 30 steps after it where y_5 - y_4 is greater than 12.
There must be a step from a to b steps after the start such that p is true at some step from l to h steps after that step.
At some step between a and b steps after the start, p is true at some step between l and h steps after that step.

Both of the following requirements must hold. There is a step s between a_1 and b_1, where a_1 and b_1 are fixed step counts, such that mu_1 holds at every step from s + a_2 to s + b_2, where a_2 and b_2 are fixed step counts. There is also a step t between a_3 and b_3, where a_3 and b_3 are fixed step counts, such that mu_3 holds at t and mu_2 holds at every step from the start up to and including t.

pi_mu_1 holds throughout the steps from step 21 to step 50, and pi_mu_2 holds at one of those steps.
x must be at most 38.6 at least once during steps 25 and 26, and y must be at least 24.1 throughout steps 11 and 12.

At least one of the following must hold: q is false at step 2; or q is false at steps 0, 1, and 2, and p is false at step 2.
q is false at step 2, or q is false at steps 0, 1, and 2, with p false at step 2.
At least one of the following must hold: airbag is true at some step within 5 steps, or airbag is true at some step from step 5 to step 10.
airbag must be true at some step within 5 steps or at some step from step 5 to step 10, or both.
There exists a step from the start onward such that a holds at that step and b does not hold at that step or at any of the 30 steps after it.
a must hold at some step, and b must not hold at that step or in the 30 steps after it.
At each step from 0 through 2, gamma_0 is true at that step or at the following step. In addition, at some step from 3 through 5, gamma_1 is true at the following step.
gamma_0 is true at or immediately after each of steps 0, 1, and 2, and gamma_1 is true immediately after some step among 3, 4, and 5.

At some step within 2 steps, y is less than 5.
At each step from step 0 through step 10, x_1 must be more than 2 at some step within five steps from that step.
Every step from 0 to 10 must have x_1 exceed 2 within five steps of that step.
At every step from the start through step 3, x must be greater than 5 at the first or second step after that step.
For steps 0–3, x must exceed 5 at the following step or the one after it.
phi_1 must hold at every step from the start through a step no earlier than c steps after the start at which phi_2 holds, where c is some fixed number of steps.
phi_1 must hold from the start through some step at least c steps after the start where phi_2 holds; c is a fixed number of steps.

There is a step, no earlier than a steps after the start and no later than b steps after the start, at which i is at most 270; q is at most 40 at every step from the start through that step. Here a and b are fixed but unspecified step counts.

The value of x_0 must be at least -11.44 at every step beginning with step 3 and continuing without limit.
From step 3 on, x_0 is at least -11.44.

From step 10 through step 25, for each step, a is less than 80 at that step, or a is less than 60 at every step from 20 steps after that step through 40 steps after that step. From step 26 through step 60, for each step, a is less than 80 at that step, or a is less than 60 at every step from 20 steps after that step through 40 steps after that step.
For every step from step 10 through step 25 and for every step from step 26 through step 60, a is less than 80 at that step, or a is less than 60 at every step from 20 to 40 steps after that step.

At least once within 1 step, x is at most 9.

psi_1 must be true at every step from step 0 to step t_b, and psi_2 must be true at some step from step t_a to step t_b, where t_a and t_b are fixed, unspecified step counts.
psi_1 holds throughout the span from the start to t_b, and psi_2 holds at some step in the span from t_a to t_b; t_a and t_b are fixed step counts.

Some step from step 4 to step 10 must be such that, if p_1 holds at that step, then p_2 holds at every step from 4 to 10 steps after it.
a must be true at every step from the start through step 4, and b must be true at some step from step 8 onward.
Keep a true for steps 0 through 4, and have b true at some step at or after step 8.
For every step from the start through step T, varphi must hold at some step from that step through T steps later, where T is a fixed number of steps.
Through step T, varphi is true within T steps from each step, where T is a fixed number of steps.

alpha holds at each step from step a to step c and at each step from step c to step b, where a, c, and b are fixed step values.

At every step from step 20 to step 30, z must be at least 20; at every step from step 60 to step 70, z must be at most 10.
z must be at least 20 during steps 20 to 30 and at most 10 during steps 60 to 70.

y must be less than 10.54 at some step between 473 and 491.

From the start to step 779, whenever n_phi_S_s1 is greater than 0, n_phi_S_s2 is greater than 1 at each step that is 8, 9, or 10 steps later.

psi_1 and psi_2 hold at each step from t_a to t_b.

x_1 must be less than 2 from the start up to and including some step between 3 and 6 at which x_3 is less than 2.

b is at most 0 at the start, and c is at least 4 within 1 step.

Both of the following conditions must hold: there is at least one step between steps 1 and 44 at which latency is less than 17, and there is at least one step between steps 13 and 52 at which backlog is greater than 13.

At every step from step 0 through step 16, if close_ref is not true at that step, then reach_ref_in_tau is true at that step.
From the start to step 16, whenever close_ref does not hold, reach_ref_in_tau holds.
At every step from step 0 to step T_1, F_1 minus F_2 is greater than d_safe, where T_1 is a fixed number of steps.
During each step in the range from step 0 through step T_1, F_1 minus F_2 is greater than d_safe; T_1 is fixed.

Within 6 steps, gamma_1_x is true at least once, and gamma_2_x is false at every step.

h stays at least 1000 from the start through step T, where T is fixed.

On every step from 199 to 298, x is no greater than 23.6 at the current step or the following step.
At some step from the start through step 4, v is more than 120, and from that step onward, omega is less than 4500 at every step.

At least one step from step 0 through step T must have varphi_i false, where T is a fixed number of steps.
varphi_i must not hold at every step from step 0 to step T, where T is a fixed number of steps.

There must be a step within 15 steps at which vx is greater than 0.1, and at that step and at each of the next 20 steps the absolute value of a_1 is less than 1, the absolute value of a_2 is less than 1, and the absolute value of a_3 is less than 1.
Within 15 steps, vx must exceed 0.1 at some step, and at that step and each of the following 20 steps the absolute values of a_1, a_2, and a_3 must each be less than 1.
It is not the case that, at all times, whenever p holds, q holds at some step from that step through b steps later, where b is a fixed number of steps.
It is not always the case that if p holds, then q holds within b steps, with b fixed.
At some step from step 0 to step t, x must be greater than 0 and less than 2, where t is a fixed number of steps.
At some step within t steps, x must be greater than 0 and less than 2, where t is a fixed number of steps.
At least one step from 15 to 18 must have y at most 33.83.
y must be no greater than 33.83 at some step between 15 and 18.
At every step within 2 steps, varphi_Sigma must not hold.
varphi_Sigma never holds within 2 steps.
varphi_2 holds at some step from step a onward, where a is a fixed number of steps, and varphi_1 holds at every step from the start through that step.
Some step at or after step a has varphi_2, and varphi_1 holds at every step from the start up to and including that step; a is a fixed number of steps.

At step 0, lev_0 is at least 10 and at most 95, and lev_1 is at least 10 and at most 95. At some step from step 30 to step 40, lev_0 is at least 50 and at most 80, and at every step from step 0 through that step the absolute value of lev_0 - lev_1 is at most 10.

At step 0, lev_0 and lev_1 are at least 10 and at most 95. Some step from step 30 to step 40 has lev_0 at least 50 and at most 80, and from step 0 through that step the absolute value of lev_0 - lev_1 is at most 10.
There is a step s from step 0 to step 10 such that a holds at s, or b holds at some step from s to s+10.
At some step from step 0 to step 10, either a holds, or b holds at some step from that step to 10 steps later.
false must hold at every step from the start onward.
At all times, false holds.
For each step s from step 0 through step 3, there must be at least one step between s and s+3 at which mu_g holds, and mu_h must hold at every step from s through that step.
On each of steps 0, 1, 2, and 3, mu_h must hold at every step from that step through some step within three steps at which mu_g holds.
At step 30 and at step 31, 4111/10000 * x - 497/1250 * y + 7749/2000 is greater than 0.
From step 30 to step 31, 4111/10000 * x - 497/1250 * y + 7749/2000 is greater than 0.
From step 1 to step 3, false must hold at every step.
false must be true at each of steps 1, 2, and 3.
At some step between steps 1 and 2, c is true. For every step from step 0 through that step, a must be true at some step at or after that step.
c holds at a step in 1–2; for each step from 0 through that step, a holds at some step at or after that step.

Where t_1 and t_2 are fixed numbers of steps, at every step, if omega is at most omega_bar at that step and at every step through t_1 steps later, then v is at most v_bar at every step from t_1 steps later through t_2 steps later.

t_1 and t_2 are fixed step counts. For any step, if omega does not exceed omega_bar from that step through t_1 steps after it, then v does not exceed v_bar from t_1 steps after it through t_2 steps after it.
At every step from a steps after the start to b steps after the start, phi_2 must hold, and phi_1 must hold at some step in that same range, where a and b are fixed but unspecified step counts.
phi_1 holds at least once and phi_2 holds throughout the range from a steps after the start to b steps after the start, with a and b fixed step counts.
For each step from step 0 to step 10, p_2 holds at every step from that step onward unless p_1 has held at some step between that step and the step under consideration.
At each step 0 through 10, p_2 stays true from that step on unless p_1 has been true somewhere between that step and the step being checked.
There is a step s between step 0 and step 10 such that, from s + 10 to s + 19, the absolute value of y is at least 2 and at most 3 at every step.
For some step s no later than step 10, the absolute value of y must be at least 2 and at most 3 on every step from s + 10 through s + 19.

At least one of the following must hold: From the start through step 100, y_4 - y_3 is less than 50 at every step. At every step from the start through step 70, y_3 - y_2 is greater than 15 at some step from that step through 30 steps later.

Either y_4 - y_3 stays below 50 at every step from the start through step 100, or, for every step from the start through step 70, y_3 - y_2 exceeds 15 at some step from that step through 30 steps later.
At every step from step 30 to step 35, p must be at least 87 and at most 87.5.
Throughout steps 30 through 35, p must have a value of at least 87 and no more than 87.5.
At least one of the following holds: a is true at the start and c is true at either step 1 or step 2; a is true at step 1 and c is true at either step 2 or step 3.
At some step from the start through step 1, a is true, and c is true one or two steps after that step.
Beginning with step 4 and continuing without limit, x_2 must be at least 21/250 at every step.
At every step from step 4 onward, x_2 is at least 21/250.
phi must hold at every step from t_a through t_b, where the step range is fixed.
phi is true throughout the fixed step range from t_a to t_b.
At each step from step 0 to step 2, there must be a step from that step through 3 steps later at which mu_g is true, and mu_h or mu_p must be true at every step from that step through that mu_g step.
For each of steps 0, 1, and 2, mu_g must be true within 3 steps, and mu_h or mu_p must be true at every step from that starting step up to and including the step where mu_g is true.
For every step from step 0 through step theta_1, a does not hold, where theta_1 is some fixed number of steps.
a must not be true at any step from the start through step theta_1, where theta_1 is a fixed number of steps.
At least one step within 30 steps must satisfy the following: if p_1 is true at that step, then p_1 is true at every step from that step through 20 steps later.
There must be a step within 30 steps where, if p_1 is true, then p_1 is true at every step from that step through 20 steps later.
For every time step from step 0 to step 30, y is greater than -25.
y is greater than -25 from the start to step 30.

It must not be the case that all of the following occur: speed is greater than 30 at some step within 10 steps; speed is less than 10 at some step between steps 10 and 20; and speed is greater than 70 at some step between steps 20 and 30.
Do not allow all three: speed above 30 within 10 steps, speed below 10 between steps 10 and 20, and speed above 70 between steps 20 and 30.
If p is true at the start, q must be true at every step from step t_1 to step t_2, where t_1 and t_2 are fixed but unspecified step counts.
If p holds at the start, q must hold at each step from t_1 to t_2; t_1 and t_2 are fixed step counts.
Both of the following must hold. From step 0 to step 6, brake is 0 at every step. From step 6 to step 30, throttle is 0 or brake is 0 at every step.
brake is 0 from step 0 to step 6, and from step 6 to step 30, at every step, throttle is 0 or brake is 0.

At the start, lev_0 must be at least 10 and at most 95, and lev_1 must be at least 10 and at most 95. At some step from step 50 through step 60, lev_0 must be at least 50 and at most 80. From the start through and including that step, the absolute difference between lev_0 and lev_1 must be at most 10.

Initially, lev_0 and lev_1 must each be at least 10 and at most 95. Somewhere from step 50 through step 60, lev_0 must be at least 50 and at most 80, and from the start through that step the absolute difference between lev_0 and lev_1 must be at most 10.
At every step from the start to step 30, if omega is at most 3000, then v is at most 100.
For each step 0 through 30, whenever omega is at most 3000, v must be at most 100.
At some step from step 0 to step 5, p_1 is true, and at some step from one to eight steps after that step, p_2 is true, with p_1 true at every step from that step through the later step.
Within 5 steps, p_1 holds from some step through a step one to eight steps later at which p_2 holds.
For every step from step 2 through step 5, both of the following are true: mu_1 is true, and mu_2 is true.
mu_1 and mu_2 are true at every step between steps 2 and 5.
During the interval from step 80 to step 90, x must be at least 5 at least once.
At some step between steps 80 and 90, x must be at least 5.
At each step within 20 steps, gear equals 4 and throttle is greater than 45.
Within 20 steps, gear must equal 4 and throttle must exceed 45 at all times.
For each step from step 5 to step 9, x_0 is at least 32.92.
x_0 must be at least 32.92 from step 5 through step 9.
If x_1 is at least 0.4 at the start, then at some step between steps 5 and 10, x_5 is at most 20.
If x_1 is at least 0.4 at the start, x_5 is at most 20 at some step between 5 and 10.
For every step, p must be true at some step from that step through u steps later, where u is a fixed number of steps.
At all times, p is true at least once within u steps of that time, where u is a fixed number of steps.
For every step from the start through step T, tau_p_P_A must be at least 23.5 and at most 24.5, where T is a fixed number of steps.
At all times within T steps of the start, tau_p_P_A must be at least 23.5 and no more than 24.5, where T is a fixed number of steps.
At every step from step 0 through step 29, either RPM is less than 4770, or RPM is greater than 1000 at that step and at the next step.
For each step from step 0 through step 29, RPM must be less than 4770, or it must be greater than 1000 at that step and the following step.
At each step from the start to step N, x is less than k, where N is a fixed nonnegative number of steps.
x remains below k at every step from the start to step N, with N a fixed nonnegative step count.
Both of the following must hold: p_1 is true at every step from step 0 through step 40, and p_4 is true at every step from step 0 through step 30.
p_1 must hold at all steps from step 0 to step 40, and p_4 must hold at all steps from step 0 to step 30.

For every step from the start through step 10, at least one of the two steps immediately after that step must be a step at which either a holds and b holds one step after that step, or a does not hold and b does not hold one step after that step.

From the start through step 10, every step must be followed within two steps by a step where either a at that step and b one step later both hold, or neither a at that step nor b one step later holds.
Within 10 steps, q must be true at every step. Within 10 steps, there must be at least one step where both p and q are true, and there must be at least one step where p is true.
q holds at every step from step 0 to step 10; p holds at least once from step 0 to step 10; and p and q hold together at least once from step 0 to step 10.
At step n, a fixed number of steps, true holds.
true must hold at step n, a fixed number of steps.
mu_1 must not be true at every step from step a to step b, where a and b are fixed numbers of steps; in other words, mu_1 must be false at least one time in that range.
mu_1 must be false at least once from step a to step b, where a and b are fixed numbers of steps.
For every step from step 0 to step 10, x must be less than -0.7 at some step from 3 to 7 steps after that step.
At every step 0 through 10, x is less than -0.7 at some step 3 through 7 steps later.
At every step from step 19 to step 58, x must be greater than 0.48 at some step from 19 to 39 steps after that step.
For each step from step 19 to step 58, x must be greater than 0.48 at some step between 19 and 39 steps later.
At all times, d is less than 5 + v.
d must always be less than 5 + v.
At every step from step 0 to step 30, v is at most 160 and omega is at most 4500.
For all steps 0 to 30, keep v no more than 160 and omega no more than 4500.
For every step s from step 2 through step 4, there is a step q from s + 3 through s + 5 such that p is true at every step from q + 1 through q + 3.
At each step from 2 to 4, some step 3 to 5 steps later must have p true at each of the three steps after it.
At some step from step a to step b, varphi_hat_1 is true.
varphi_hat_1 must hold at least once between steps a and b.
For each step from step 0 through step 24, there must be at least one step from that step through 12 steps later at which xi is at most 27.44.
Across steps 0 through 24, xi must be at most 27.44 at least once from each step through 12 steps later.
At every step from the start through step 50, it must not be the case that x1 is at least 7 and at most 8 and that x2 is at least 9 and at most 10.
For each of the first 51 steps, x1 being at least 7 and at most 8, together with x2 being at least 9 and at most 10, must not occur.

At least one of the following holds: Reg_3_3 is true for six consecutive steps starting at some step between step 0 and step 15, or Reg_1_3 is true for six consecutive steps starting at some step between step 0 and step 15.
Starting at or before step 15, at least one six-step true interval exists, for Reg_3_3 or for Reg_1_3.
y must be greater than 5 at some step from the start through step 10.
y must exceed 5 at least once within 10 steps.
At some step between steps 12 and 13, x_1 - 1.1 is at least 0, and at some step between steps 2 and 3, 1.7 - x_1 is at least 0.
x_1 - 1.1 is at least 0 at step 12 or step 13, and 1.7 - x_1 is at least 0 at step 2 or step 3.
AQI must be less than lambda at some step within 10 steps.
AQI must be less than lambda within 10 steps.
There must be a step between steps 1 and 15 such that G_bar_S is true at that step and at the next four steps. There must also be a step between steps 21 and 39 at which Y_bar_S is true.
G_bar_S must be true at five consecutive steps beginning at some step between 1 and 15, and Y_bar_S must be true at some step between 21 and 39.
Within 3 steps from the start, x must be less than 0 at least once.
x is less than 0 at least once within 3 steps.
mu_1 must hold at every step from step 3 to step 94, and mu_2 must hold at step 116.
mu_1 holds at steps 3 through 94; mu_2 holds at step 116.
At every step from t_0 through t_e, at least one of u_1 or u_3 is true at some step from that step through t_s steps later.
At each step between t_0 and t_e, at least one of u_1 or u_3 must be true within t_s steps.
At some step from step 36 to step 41, SENSOR_11 is less than 49.77, and at some step from step 45 to step 52, SENSOR_11 is less than 49.39.
SENSOR_11 is less than 49.77 at some step between steps 36 and 41, and less than 49.39 at some step between steps 45 and 52.
At every step from the start through step 10, omega is less than omega_bar.
omega is less than omega_bar at each step from 0 through 10.
At every step from the start onward, pi must be true at some step no fewer than i steps after that step, where i is a fixed number of steps.
No step from the start onward may lack a step no fewer than i steps after it at which pi is true, where i is a fixed number of steps.
For each step from the start through step 40, rpm must be less than 4000.
rpm stays below 4000 at all times within 40 steps of the start.
For every step from step a to step b, phi must hold at some step from c steps after that step to d steps after that step, where a, b, c, and d are fixed numbers of steps.
At each step from a to b, phi must be true between c and d steps later, where a, b, c, and d are fixed step counts.
Within a steps, where a is a fixed number of steps, there must be a step at which x is at most 9.
x must be at most 9 at least once within a steps, where a is a fixed number of steps.
At least one step within 5 steps from the start must have both mu_2 and mu_3 true.
mu_2 and mu_3 must both hold at some step within 5 steps.
If rpm is at most 3000 at every step from step 0 through step 30, then speed is at most 35 at every step from step 0 through step 4.
When rpm does not exceed 3000 at any step from the start through step 30, speed must not exceed 35 at any step from the start through step 4.
For every step from 0 to 24, there must be a step from that step through 12 steps later at which xi is at most 37.26.
At each step from 0 to 24, xi is at most 37.26 within the next 12 steps.
There must be a step within k steps of the start at which Phi_2 holds, and Phi_1 must hold at every step from the start through that step, where k is a fixed number of steps.
Phi_1 holds from the start up to and including a step within k steps at which Phi_2 holds; k is a fixed number of steps.
At some step from step 0 to step 1800, altitude must be greater than 3048 and speed must be at least 102.89.
By step 1800, there must be a step where altitude exceeds 3048 and speed is no less than 102.89.

For every step in the window from a through b after the start, mu_h must hold at every step in the window from that step plus a_prime through that step plus b_prime, where a, b, a_prime, and b_prime are fixed step counts.
mu_h must hold, for each step in the a-to-b window after the start, at every step from that step plus a_prime through that step plus b_prime; a, b, a_prime, and b_prime are fixed step counts.
There must be at least one step from step 0 through step 6 at which I is no greater than 23 and R_sig is no less than 62.
Within 6 steps, I must be at most 23 and R_sig at least 62 at the same step.
At every step from step 0 through step 5, x must be at least 0 at some step from that step through 4 steps later.
In steps 0 to 5, x is at least 0 within 4 steps of each step.
For every step from the start through step 30, if gear equals 4, then speed must be at least 35.
At each step from step 0 to step 30, speed is at least 35 whenever gear is 4.
At least one step from step 15 through step 30 must occur in which speed is less than 30 or speed is greater than 40.
Between steps 15 and 30, at some step speed is less than 30 or greater than 40.
psi_1 must be true at some step in the fixed a_1-to-b_1 step window from the start, and psi_2 must be true at every step in the fixed a_2-to-b_2 step window from the start.
Somewhere in the fixed a_1-to-b_1 step window from the start, psi_1 is true; throughout the fixed a_2-to-b_2 step window from the start, psi_2 is true.
From step 13 onward, x_0 must be at most 24.64 at every step.
x_0 must be no greater than 24.64 at all steps from step 13 on.
For each step from step 0 to step 1, varphi must be true at that step or one step later.
At step 0 and step 1, varphi must hold within one step.
From step 5 to step 30, the absolute difference between ball_pos and tool_pos must be at most 0.1.
Between steps 5 and 30, ball_pos and tool_pos must differ by no more than 0.1.

Some step s, either 2 or 3, must satisfy the following: a must hold at every step from the start through s. Some step u, either s+3 or s+4, must satisfy: c must hold at u, and b must hold at every step from s through u.
For some step s that is 2 or 3, a must hold from the start through s, and for some step three or four steps after s, c must hold at that step and b must hold from s through that step.
p is true at the start, and p is true at each step from the start to step 10.
p holds at the start and at all steps 0 to 10.

For every step from the start through step 10, there must be a step within 10 steps from that step where both mu_1 and mu_2 are true. Also, mu_4 must not be true at any step from the start through step 20.
Each step through step 10 must have both mu_1 and mu_2 true at one step within 10 steps; mu_4 must not hold from the start through step 20.
For every step from step 17 to step 19, x is greater than 88.62 and less than 152.21, and y is greater than 45.47 and less than 89.73.
At each step between steps 17 and 19, x is above 88.62 and below 152.21, and y is above 45.47 and below 89.73.
During the interval from the start through step 10, sigma must at some step be greater than 1 and less than 3.
Some step within 10 steps from the start must have sigma greater than 1 and less than 3.
At every step from the start onward, either omega is less than 4770 at that step, or omega is greater than 600 at the immediately following step.
At all times, either omega is less than 4770, or omega is greater than 600 one step later.
There must be a step between step a and step b at which psi holds, and phi must hold at every step from the start through that step.
phi must hold from the start through a step between step a and step b where psi holds.
At some step from the start through step i (a fixed number of steps), x is less than or equal to v.
Within i steps (a fixed number of steps), x is less than or equal to v at least once.
Out must be less than 2 at some step from step 0 to step 10.
Out must be less than 2 at least once within 10 steps.
For every step from step 0 to step 10, paceCount must be at most 15; also, for some step from step 0 to step 10, paceCount must be at least 8.
paceCount must be at most 15 at all steps from step 0 to step 10 and must be at least 8 at one of those steps.
At step 5, a must be true.
a holds at step 5.
If varphi holds at all times from the start onward, then varphi holds at the start.
If varphi is always true, then it is true at the start.

From step 21 to step 45, theta must be less than 0.07 at every step. From step 23 to step 32, v must be greater than -0.17 at every step. From step 14 to step 50, omega must be greater than -0.79 at every step. At some step from 19 to 37, omega must be greater than -0.16.
theta is below 0.07 throughout steps 21 to 45, v is above -0.17 throughout steps 23 to 32, omega is above -0.79 throughout steps 14 to 50, and omega is above -0.16 at some step between 19 and 37.

At every step, if act_2 holds, then either c holds at that step and, at each of that step and the step immediately after it, if act_2 holds then a holds; or c does not hold at that step and it is not the case that, at each of that step and the step immediately after it, if act_2 holds then a holds. In addition, at step 0 both act_2 and c hold.

Always, when act_2 is true, either c is true and, at every step in the two-step stretch starting at that step, if act_2 is true then a is true; or c is false and it is not the case that, at every step in that two-step stretch, if act_2 is true then a is true. Step 0 must have act_2 and c true.

x must satisfy three conditions. First, for every step from step 0 through step 20, there must exist a step from that step through 10 steps later at which x is at least 10 and at most 11. Second, there must exist a step from step 0 through step 15 at which x is at least 4 and at most 5. Third, there must exist a step from step 20 through step 30 at which x is at least 2 and at most 3.

For every step from step 0 through step 20, x must be at least 10 and at most 11 at some step from that step through 10 steps later; x must be at least 4 and at most 5 at some step from step 0 through step 15; and x must be at least 2 and at most 3 at some step from step 20 through step 30.
If, at each step from step 0 to step 50, EngineSpeed is greater than 910 or PedalAngle is greater than 25, then mu is less than 9/40 at each step from step 11 to step 50.
Whenever every step from step 0 to step 50 has EngineSpeed greater than 910 or PedalAngle greater than 25, mu must be less than 9/40 at every step from step 11 to step 50.

At some step between steps 2 and 10, x is more than 3.5 and at most 4, and y is more than -0.2 and at most 0.2. At every step from step 0 to step 2, y is more than -0.5 and at most 0.5. At every step from step 0 to step 10, if x is more than 2 and at most 3, then y is more than 0.5 or x is at most -0.5.

y is above -0.5 and at most 0.5 at each step from step 0 to step 2; at some step from step 2 to step 10, x is above 3.5 and at most 4 and y is above -0.2 and at most 0.2; and at each step from step 0 to step 10, whenever x is above 2 and at most 3, y is above 0.5 or x is at most -0.5.
For each step from step 2 through step 4, if p_1 is true at that step, then p_2 must be true at some step from 3 to 10 steps after that step.
At steps 2, 3, and 4, if p_1 holds, p_2 holds at some step 3 through 10 steps later.
At each step from step 11 through step 50, mu is less than 0.22.
mu stays below 0.22 at every step from 11 to 50.
There is a step at which a holds, and c holds at that step or within two steps after it.
Eventually a holds, and c holds within two steps after that step, including that step.
The system must not have the following behavior: at every step from step 0 to step 20, x_0 is at most 0.3 at every step from five steps after that step to ten steps after that step.
Not every step from step 0 to step 20 has x_0 at most 0.3 throughout the steps from five steps later to ten steps later.
For every step from the start to step 80, and for every step from that step to 20 steps after it, y_2 - y_1 is at most 20.
At each step from the start to step 80, y_2 - y_1 must be no more than 20 at that step and at each of the next 20 steps.
At least one of the following must hold: v is less than 90 at every step from the start through step 26, or v is greater than 50 at step 28.
v must be below 90 at every step from the start through step 26, or it must exceed 50 at step 28, or both.

There is a step at which diagonalBehind_s is true and, at the step immediately following it, stayPos is true. At some step at least six steps after that stayPos step, both alignedHeading_s and aboveTouchdown_s are true. From that aligned step onward, at some step, descended_s is true.

diagonalBehind_s is true at some step; stayPos is true at the following step; at some step at least six steps after that stayPos step, alignedHeading_s and aboveTouchdown_s are both true; and descended_s is true at some step from that aligned step onward.

At every step from the start through step 100, if g_2 holds at that step and g_1 holds at the next step, then at every step from that step through the step 97 steps later, if tau is at most 97, g_1 holds.
For each step from the start to step 100, if g_2 holds at that step and g_1 holds one step later, then g_1 holds at every step from that step to 97 steps later whenever tau is at most 97.
At every step from step 16 to step 18, x + 15.28 is at least 0.
x + 15.28 is at least 0 at each step between step 16 and step 18.
For every step from step a to step b, mu_h holds at some step no earlier than a_prime steps and no later than b_prime steps after that step, where a, b, a_prime, and b_prime are fixed step counts.
Every step from step a to step b must have mu_h hold at some step from a_prime to b_prime steps after it; a, b, a_prime, and b_prime are fixed step counts.
There must be a step between steps a and b at which q holds, and p must not hold at any step from the start through that step.
q must hold at some step from step a to step b, and p must not hold from the start up to and including that step.
From step 0 to step 10, omega must be less than 4750 at every step.
omega remains below 4750 throughout steps 0–10.
At some step from step 0 to step 30, the absolute difference between ball_pos and hole_pos must be no more than 0.5.
Within 30 steps, ball_pos and hole_pos must be within 0.5 of each other.
For every step from step 0 to step 12, regionA must be true at some step from that step through two steps later, and regionB must be true at some step from that step through two steps later.
At every step from 0 to 12, regionA and regionB each must be true at least once in the three-step window starting at that step.
At some step from step 15 to step 30, gear must differ from 4.
Between steps 15 and 30, gear is not 4 at least once.

At some step from step 27 to step 35, mu_3 must be true at every step from that chosen step through a later step that is from 2 to 10 steps after it and at which mu_1 is true. mu_4 must not be true at any step from step 0 to step 50. mu_5 must be true at some step from step 37 to step 50.

mu_1 must be true 5 to 7 steps after each of steps 0, 1, and 2; mu_2 must be true for four consecutive steps starting 2 steps after some step from step 15 to step 17; mu_3 must be true at every step from some step from step 27 to step 35 through a step 2 to 10 steps later where mu_1 is true; mu_4 must not be true at any step from step 0 to step 50; and mu_5 must be true at some step from step 37 to step 50.
At every step from the start through step 5, X_1 + X_2 + u must be at least 0.
X_1 + X_2 + u remains at least 0 from the start through step 5.
There is a step at which psi_2 is true such that psi_1 is true at every step from the start through that step.
psi_1 must hold from the start through some step at which psi_2 is true.
Both of the following must hold: p_1 is true at some step from step 0 to step 30, and p_1 is true at some step from step 0 to step 20.
p_1 is true within 30 steps, and p_1 is true within 20 steps.
For every step from 200 through 600, glucose must be at least 70 at some step from that step through 180 steps later.
No step between 200 and 600 may have glucose below 70 at every step up to and including 180 steps later.
x_mu_1 must be true at some step between step 2 and step 7, and x_mu_2 must be true at every step from step 3 through step 12.
x_mu_1 true once in steps 2-7; x_mu_2 true at all steps 3-12.
q is true at the start, and p holds at every step from the start through t steps later, where t is a fixed number of steps.
q holds at the start, and p holds at every step from the start through t steps later.
At the start, at least one of a and b is true. In addition, c is true at some step within T steps of the start, where T is a fixed number of steps.
a or b is true at the start, and c is true at some step within T steps, where T is a fixed number of steps.
At least one step from step a through step b must have varphi_i true, varphi_j true, or both; a and b are fixed step counts.
Between steps a and b, at least one of varphi_i and varphi_j holds, where a and b are fixed step counts.
At the start, rise equals theta and theta is less than 8.8. Also, at some step from the start through epsilon steps after the start, theta is more than 40, where epsilon is a fixed number of steps.
Initially, rise equals theta and theta is less than 8.8; within epsilon steps, theta is more than 40, where epsilon is a fixed step count.
At some step between 23 and 45, backlog is greater than 2, and at every step between 21 and 39, backlog is less than 75.
backlog must exceed 2 at least once between steps 23 and 45, and must be less than 75 at all steps between 21 and 39.
At every step, there is a step from one to four steps later such that adeq_gap holds at each of the two steps immediately after that step.
For every step, some step one to four steps later is followed by two consecutive steps in which adeq_gap is true.
If RPM is less than 4500 at every step from the start through step 30, then speed is less than 80 at every step from the start through step 10.
If RPM is below 4500 at all steps from step 0 through step 30, speed is below 80 at all steps from step 0 through step 10.
psi must be true at some step from the start onward, and gamma must be true at every step from the start through that step.
gamma must hold from the start through some step at which psi holds, however late that step is.

At least one of the following holds: some step from the start through step 5 is such that x is at least 0.4 at every step from 15 steps after that step through 25 steps after that step; or x is at least 0.12 at every step from the start through step 5.

Either x is at least 0.12 at every step from the start through step 5, or some step from the start through step 5 is such that x is at least 0.4 at every step from 15 steps after it through 25 steps after it, or both.
At every step from step 0 to step 100, y_5 - y_4 must be at most 40.
y_5 - y_4 stays no greater than 40 throughout steps 0 through 100.

At least one of the following holds: p does not hold at all times; there is a step between steps 7 and 9 at which p does not hold, and p holds at every step from the start up to and including that step.
p never holds, or there is a step between steps 7 and 9 where p does not hold and p holds at every step from the start up to and including that step.
There is a step between step 2 and step 10 at which p_2 is true. For every step from the start through that step, p_1 is true at every step from the step in question through 5 steps later.
p_2 is true at some step between step 2 and step 10, and from the start through that step, p_1 is true at every step and for the next 5 steps after each step.

At each step from the start through step 2, there must be a step from that step through 3 steps later at which mu_g or mu_p is true, with mu_h or mu_s true at every step from that step through that chosen step.
For each step from the start through step 2, mu_h or mu_s must hold from that step up to and including a step within 3 steps where mu_g or mu_p holds.
At step 0, A_prime must be false and A_prime_prime must be false. In addition, phi must be true at some step after step 0.
A_prime and A_prime_prime are both false at the start, and phi is true at some step from step 1 on.
If w is less than 3000 at every step from the start through step 30, then v is less than 65 at every step from the start through step 20.
If w is under 3000 at all steps 0 through 30, then v is under 65 at all steps 0 through 20.

mu_R1_det must be true at some step within 5 steps. For every step from the start onward, mu_O1_det and mu_O2_det must be true. Additionally, at each such step, if mu_uc is true at that step or the next step, then mu_R2_det must be true at some step from that step through three steps later.
mu_R1_det is true within 5 steps; at all times, mu_O1_det and mu_O2_det are true, and, at each step, if mu_uc is true within 1 step, mu_R2_det is true within 3 steps.

At each step from step 2 to step 4, rc must be true at some step that is at least 3 and at most 5 steps after that step, and weps must be true at some step that is at least 2 and at most 6 steps after that step.
At every one of steps 2, 3, and 4, rc must be true at a step 3 to 5 steps later and weps must be true at a step 2 to 6 steps later.
At every step from step 1 through step 15, the quantity formed by taking 2649/10000 times x, subtracting 617/2000 times y, and then adding 5917/1000 must be greater than 0.
Throughout steps 1 to 15, 2649/10000 times x minus 617/2000 times y plus 5917/1000 is greater than 0.
At least one of the following holds: p holds at the start; q holds at step 0 or step 1.
p at step 0, or q at step 0 or 1.
For every time step from the start onward, if In is more than 5, then within 10 steps from that time step, Out is less than 2.
Always, whenever In is more than 5, Out is less than 2 within 10 steps.
At every step from the start through step 80, within 20 steps from that step, at least one of the following must hold: y_2 - y_1 is less than 45, or y_5 - y_4 is greater than 20.
Each step from step 0 to step 80 must have some step within 20 steps at which y_2 - y_1 is less than 45 or y_5 - y_4 is greater than 20.
At some step between steps 5 and 15, either e is greater than 100 or q is greater than 25, and q is at most 50 at every step from the start through that step.
From the start through a step between 5 and 15, q stays at most 50, and at that step e exceeds 100 or q exceeds 25.

At the start, tempe is at least 10 and at most 90. There is a step between 15 and 20 at which tempe is at least 40 and at most 50, and at every step from the start through that step, cooling is at least 0 and at most 1.
tempe starts at least 10 and at most 90; cooling is at least 0 and at most 1 from the start through a step between 15 and 20 at which tempe is at least 40 and at most 50.
x must be at most 1.2 at every step from step 0 through step 10.
x is at most 1.2 in steps 0 through 10.
At every step from step 0 through step 30, if gear equals 4, then rpm must be greater than rho at that same step.
From step 0 to step 30, whenever gear is 4, rpm is greater than rho.
x_1 must be at least 1 at every step from step 144 through step 216, and it must be at least 1 at every step from step 372 through step 444.
x_1 must be at least 1 on every step from 144 to 216 and on every step from 372 to 444.
From the start through step 6, at each step both of the following must hold: x is greater than 1.7, and y is less than 2.
At every step from the start to step 6, x is greater than 1.7 and y is less than 2.
rho must be true at some step from step x to step y, where x and y are fixed but unspecified numbers of steps.
rho holds at least once between step x and step y.

For every step from step 0 through step 8, I is at most 60 at that step, and I is at least 85 at some step from that step through six steps later. For every step from step 0 through step 12, S is at most 40 at some step from that step through fifteen steps later.
On each step from step 0 through step 8, I is at most 60 and I is at least 85 at some step within 6 steps; on each step from step 0 through step 12, S is at most 40 at some step within 15 steps.

If mu is true at the start and mu is not true at any step from a steps after the start through b steps after the start, then varphi is true at the start, where a and b are fixed but unspecified numbers of steps.

varphi must hold at the start whenever mu holds at the start and mu does not hold at any step from a steps after the start to b steps after the start, with a and b fixed but unspecified numbers of steps.
At some step between steps 16 and 19, d_2 must be less than 101.
d_2 is less than 101 somewhere between steps 16 and 19.
gamma_0 must be true at every step from step 0 to step 4, and gamma_1 must be true at every step from step 2 to step 6.
gamma_0 holds throughout steps 0 to 4, while gamma_1 holds throughout steps 2 to 6.

There must be at least one step from the start through step T, where T is a fixed number of steps, at which x is greater than 0 and at least one of the following holds: y is greater than 0, or z is greater than 0.
Within T steps, where T is a fixed number of steps, some step must have x greater than 0 and either y greater than 0 or z greater than 0, or both.
Within i_1 steps of the start, where i_1 is a fixed but unspecified number of steps, there must be some step at which x is at most v_1.
At some step within i_1 steps, a fixed but unspecified number of steps, x must be at most v_1.
At every step from step 0 to step 40, if p_1 is true at that step, then p_1 must be true at that step and at each of the 10 steps after it.
Whenever p_1 is true at a step from 0 to 40, p_1 must hold at that step and at the next 10 steps.
At some step between steps 2 and 3, x_1 - 0.7 is at least 0, and at some step between steps 2 and 3, 1.3 - x_1 is at least 0.
x_1 - 0.7 must be at least 0 at step 2 or step 3, and 1.3 - x_1 must be at least 0 at step 2 or step 3.
At some step within 20 steps from the start, S is at least 60.
S must be at least 60 within 20 steps.
From step 25 through step 30, at every step the absolute value of obj_pos minus hole_pos must be less than or equal to 0.12.
During steps 25 through 30, obj_pos and hole_pos must differ by at most 0.12 in absolute value.
phi_1 must hold at every step from the start up to and including some step between t_1 and t_2, and phi_2 must hold at that step.
At some step between t_1 and t_2, phi_2 is true and phi_1 has been true at every step from the start through that step.
Either x_1 is less than 5 at every step from step 0 to step 5, or there is at least one step from step 0 to step 5 at which the absolute value of x_2 - x_3 is more than 2.
x_1 is less than 5 at every step 0 through 5, or the absolute value of x_2 - x_3 is more than 2 at some step 0 through 5.

The following three conditions must not all occur: speed is more than 50 at some step between step 0 and step 10; gear is less than 2 at some step between step 10 and step 20; and gear is more than 3 at some step between step 20 and step 30.
It must not be the case that speed is more than 50 within 10 steps, gear is less than 2 between steps 10 and 20, and gear is more than 3 between steps 20 and 30.
For every step from t_a through t_b, psi_1 must hold and psi_2 must hold.
psi_1 and psi_2 must each be true at all steps between t_a and t_b.
If x is greater than c_1 at the start, then x must be less than c_2 at every step from step 0 through step tau_2, where tau_2 is a fixed but unspecified number of steps.
If x is greater than c_1 at step 0, x must be less than c_2 at each step through step tau_2, a fixed step count.
phi_1 must be true at every step from step a_1 to step b_1, where a_1 and b_1 are fixed numbers of steps.
At each step from a_1 to b_1, phi_1 holds, with a_1 and b_1 fixed.

At some step s from the start onward, p holds at every step from s through a step s1 that is one or two steps after s. At s1, p holds at every step from s1 through a step s2 that is one or two steps after s1. At s2, p holds at every step from s2 through a step s3 that is one or two steps after s2, and q holds at s3.
Eventually, p must hold at every step across three consecutive one- or two-step intervals, and q must hold at the end of the third.
Within 5 steps, there is a step such that x is less than 0.1 at every step from 20 to 25 steps after that step; and from step 65 to step 72, x is at least 0.3.
Some step within 5 steps must be such that x is less than 0.1 at every step 20 through 25 after it, and x must be at least 0.3 from step 65 to step 72.
At every step, if glucose is greater than 200, then glucose is less than 200 at some step within 25 steps of that step.
Any step where glucose exceeds 200 must have a step within 25 steps where glucose is below 200.
At some step within i steps of the start, x is at most 10, where i is a fixed number of steps.
For a fixed step count i, x must be at most 10 at some step within i steps.
At least one of the following must hold: v is less than 90 at every step from the start through step 26, or v is greater than 60 at step 28.
The requirement is met if v stays below 90 at every step from the start through step 26, or if v exceeds 60 at step 28.
At some step no earlier than step a, p holds, where a is some fixed number of steps.
p must be true at some step from step a onward.

At some step from the start through step 18, x is more than 3 and at most 4, and y is more than 2 and at most 3. At every step from the start through step 6, it must not be the case that x is more than 1 and at most 2 while y is more than 2 and at most 3.

Within 18 steps of the start, there must be a step at which x is more than 3 and at most 4, and y is more than 2 and at most 3. From the start through step 6, the combination of x being more than 1 and at most 2 with y being more than 2 and at most 3 must not occur.

For every step from the start to step 30, if gear equals 1 then speed is less than 80; if gear equals 2 then speed is less than 90; if gear equals 3 then speed is greater than 20; and if gear equals 4 then speed is greater than 30.

At every step from step 0 to step 30, speed is less than 80 whenever gear equals 1, less than 90 whenever gear equals 2, greater than 20 whenever gear equals 3, and greater than 30 whenever gear equals 4.
Either v is less than p_1 at every step from the start through step 26, or v is greater than p_2 at step 28, or both.
v is less than p_1 from step 0 to step 26, or v is greater than p_2 at step 28, or both.
v must be greater than 0.5 at some step within 15 steps, and at every step from step 0 to step 20, z must be greater than 0.7 and the absolute value of a must be less than 1.
Within 15 steps, v must be greater than 0.5; from step 0 to step 20, z must be greater than 0.7 and the absolute value of a must be less than 1.
If p is true at the start, then q is true at some step between steps t_1 and t_2, where t_1 and t_2 are fixed step counts.
If p holds at the start, q holds somewhere between steps t_1 and t_2, where t_1 and t_2 are fixed.
At some step from the start through step 15, robot_moving equals 0.
Within 15 steps, robot_moving must be 0 at least once.

For every step from step 0 through step 100, it must not be the case that e is more than 0.1 at some step two to three steps later while the quantities (r - prev_r) / 0.01 and (x - prev_x) / 0.01 are each less than 0.01 at every step from that step through that later step.

No step from step 0 through step 100 may have e more than 0.1 at a step two or three steps later while (r - prev_r) / 0.01 and (x - prev_x) / 0.01 are each less than 0.01 at every step from that earlier step through that later step.
Either Reg_3_3 holds at some step within 20 steps of the start, or Reg_2_2 holds at some step within 20 steps of the start, or both.
Within 20 steps of the start, Reg_3_3 or Reg_2_2 must hold at least once.
At some step from 1 to 3 after the start, s_0 must equal 0.
s_0 equals 0 at least once between steps 1 and 3 after the start.

All of the following must hold: at some step between 60 and 68, x is less than 0.1; at some step between 44 and 50, x is at least 0.08; and at some step between 0 and 5, x is less than 0.3 at every step from 18 steps after that step through 30 steps after that step.

x must be less than 0.1 at some step between 60 and 68, at least 0.08 at some step between 44 and 50, and less than 0.3 at every step from 18 steps after some step within 5 steps through 30 steps after that step.

It must not be the case that all three of the following hold: gear equals 3 at every step from step 5 to step 10; gear equals 2 at every step from step 15 to step 20; and gear equals 1 at every step from step 25 to step 30.
At least one of these must fail: gear equals 3 at every step from step 5 to step 10, gear equals 2 at every step from step 15 to step 20, or gear equals 1 at every step from step 25 to step 30.
At every step, if resting_i is true, then resting_i is not true at some step from 3 to 5 steps later.
Whenever resting_i holds, resting_i must be false at some step 3 to 5 steps later.

Either s_1 is at least 7 at every step from step 1 through step 5, or s_2 is at most 2 at every step from step 1 through step 5. In addition, either s_1 is at most 3 at some step from step 5 through step 10, or s_2 is at least 8 at some step from step 5 through step 10.

Either s_1 is at least 7 at every step from step 1 to step 5, or s_2 is at most 2 at every step from step 1 to step 5; and at some step from step 5 to step 10, either s_1 is at most 3 or s_2 is at least 8.

All of the following must hold. mu_1 must be true at some step within 20 steps, and mu_4 must not be true at any step from the start through that step. mu_2 must be true at some step from step 20 to step 40, and mu_5 must not be true at any step from the start through that step. mu_3 must be true at some step within 60 steps.

mu_1 must be true within 20 steps with no mu_4 from the start through that step; mu_2 must be true between steps 20 and 40 with no mu_5 from the start through that step; and mu_3 must be true within 60 steps.
If EngineSpeed is greater than 1000 at any step from the start through step 50, then mu is less than 9/40 at every step from step 11 through step 50.
If EngineSpeed exceeds 1000 anywhere from step 0 through step 50, mu must stay below 9/40 at all steps from step 11 through step 50.
There is no step between steps 200 and 600 such that, from that step through 180 steps later, glucose is at least 240 at every step.
At every step between 200 and 600, some step from that step through 180 steps later has glucose below 240.
At some step within 10 steps, x must be less than -3.
x must be below -3 at least once within 10 steps.
At every step from step 0 through step 15, x must be at least 0. Additionally, at some step from step 0 through step 8, x must be at least 10.
x must be at least 0 at every step from the start through step 15, and at least 10 at some step from the start through step 8.

At every step from 8 to 29, a must be at least 80 at some step from that step through 15 steps later. At every step from 30 to 55, a must be at least 80 at some step from that step through 15 steps later. At every step from 10 to 60, either a is less than 80 at that step, or a is less than 60 at every step from 20 steps after that step through 40 steps after that step.

For every step from 8 to 29 and every step from 30 to 55, a must be at least 80 at some step from that step to 15 steps later. For every step from 10 to 60, either a is less than 80 at that step, or a is less than 60 at each step from 20 to 40 steps after that step.

All of the following must hold: at some step within 40 steps, p_1 or p_3 is true; at some step within 40 steps, p_2 is true; and at some step within 40 steps, p_1 is true at every step from that step through 30 steps later.
Within 40 steps, p_1 or p_3 is true at some step, p_2 is true at some step, and p_1 is true for 31 consecutive steps starting at some step.

It must not be the case that all of the following are true: gear is exactly 2 at every step from step 5 to step 10, gear is exactly 3 at every step from step 15 to step 20, and gear is exactly 4 at every step from step 25 to step 30.
At least one of these must be false: gear equals 2 at every step from step 5 to step 10, gear equals 3 at every step from step 15 to step 20, or gear equals 4 at every step from step 25 to step 30.

b must hold at some step between steps 1 and 4, and a must hold at every step from the start through that step. There must also be a step s between steps 3 and 5 at which d holds, and for every step t from the start through s, c must hold at some step between 5 and 10 steps after t.

b must hold at some step from 1 to 4, with a holding from the start through that step. d must hold at some step from 3 to 5, and each step from the start through that step must have c hold at some step from 5 to 10 steps later.
At every step from step 3 to step 29, 2661/10000 * x + 553/2500 * y - 61891/10000 must be greater than 0.
At steps 3 through 29, 2661/10000 * x + 553/2500 * y - 61891/10000 must exceed 0.
Within T steps of the start, where T is a fixed number of steps, there must be a step such that Reach_A is true at that step and at each of the next 5 steps.
Some step within T steps of the start, where T is a fixed number of steps, begins a 6-step run during which Reach_A is true at every step.
At some step, varphi_1 is true and, from that step through t steps later, varphi_2 is true at least once, where t is a fixed number of steps.
At some step, varphi_1 holds and varphi_2 holds within t steps of that step, where t is a fixed number of steps.
Both of the following must hold: x is greater than 5 at every step from the start through 10 steps after the start, and x is less than 0 at some step from the start through 11 steps after the start.
x is greater than 5 at all times from the start through 10 steps later, and x is less than 0 within 11 steps.

At some step no later than 33 steps after the start, both of the following must hold: y is greater than 19.88 at every step from 18 through 23 steps after that step, and x is less than 34.08 at every step from 9 through 30 steps after that step.
Some step no later than 33 steps after the start must be such that y is greater than 19.88 on each step from 18 through 23 after it and x is less than 34.08 on each step from 9 through 30 after it.
From the start through step 30, at every step, at least one of the following holds: throttle is at most 20; brake is at most 50.
At every step within 30 steps, throttle is at most 20 or brake is at most 50, or both.
At each step from step 0 to step 30, if gear equals 3, then speed is greater than rho.
At every step in the first 31 steps, whenever gear equals 3, speed must be greater than rho.
At least one of the following must hold: x_151 is greater than 0.07 at every step from step 3 through step 4; x_151 is less than 0.07 at at least one of step 4 and step 5.
Either x_151 exceeds 0.07 at both step 3 and step 4, or it is less than 0.07 at step 4 or step 5.
At some step between step 0 and step 7, x must be at least 0.2.
x must reach at least 0.2 within 7 steps.

There must be a step s no earlier than a steps after the start and no later than b steps after the start such that varphi_i holds at every step no earlier than c steps after s and no later than d steps after s, where a, b, c, and d are fixed but unspecified step counts.
Some step s between a and b after the start must have varphi_i true from c steps after s through d steps after s; a, b, c, and d are fixed step counts.
There must be at least one step between steps 3 and 5 at which sigma is no less than 0 and no more than 5.
At one of steps 3, 4, or 5, sigma must be at least 0 and at most 5.
At each step between step 5 and step 20, the absolute value of ball_pos - tray_pos must be at most 0.25.
From step 5 through step 20, ball_pos and tray_pos must be at most 0.25 apart.

If the absolute value of y is less than 2.5 at every step from step 0 to step 10 and the absolute value of y is less than 2.5 at every step from step 20 to step 30, then the absolute value of y must be less than 5 at every step from step 10 to step 20.
When the absolute value of y is less than 2.5 on all steps 0 to 10 and on all steps 20 to 30, it must be less than 5 on all steps 10 to 20.
At some step between steps 5 and 18, G_bar_T is true from that step through five steps later, and at some step between steps 24 and 39, Y_bar_T is true.
G_bar_T is true for the six steps starting at some step from step 5 to step 18, and Y_bar_T is true at some step from step 24 to step 39.

All of the following must be satisfied: p1 holds at at least one step between steps 1 and 2; p2 holds at at least one step between steps 1 and 2; p3 holds at at least one step between steps 1 and 2; p4 holds at at least one step between steps 1 and 2; p5 holds at at least one step between steps 1 and 2.
p1, p2, p3, p4, and p5 must each hold at at least one of step 1 or step 2.
At some step between step 0 and step 17, there must begin a period of 8 consecutive steps, from that step through 7 steps later, during which I is at least 77 and R_sig is at most 71 at every step.
Within 17 steps, some block of 8 consecutive steps must have I at least 77 and R_sig at most 71 at every step.
At some step between steps 8 and 10, the absolute value of x_5 - x_2 must be at most 0.25.
x_5 and x_2 must differ in absolute value by at most 0.25 at some step between steps 8 and 10.
At the start, p is false and phi_3 is true. In addition, p must not hold at any step from the start through step 8.
p is false at the start, phi_3 is true at the start, and p is not true at any step from the start through step 8.
At some step from step 0 through step 5, x must be at least 10.
x must be at least 10 within 5 steps.
At least one step from step a_2 to step b_2 must have phi true, where a_2 and b_2 are fixed, unspecified step counts.
phi must hold at least once from step a_2 to step b_2, where a_2 and b_2 are fixed step counts.
At every step from step 476 to step 496, v_z must be greater than 1.03 and y must be greater than 2.65.
From step 476 to step 496, keep v_z more than 1.03 and y more than 2.65.
Within T steps from the start, where T is a fixed number of steps, there is a step at which both g_2 and r_1 are true.
At least once within T steps of the start, T being a fixed step count, g_2 and r_1 hold at the same step.
At least one step between steps 40 and 60 after the start must satisfy that the absolute value of p_3 minus p_C is no greater than epsilon.
At some step from step 40 to step 60, the absolute value of p_3 - p_C must be at most epsilon.
At some step from the start through step 10, x must be at most 24.86, and y must be at least 19.74 at every step from the start up to and including that step.
x must be at most 24.86 within 10 steps, and y must stay at least 19.74 from the start through that step.
At some step within T steps, S_i is at most S_j, where T is some fixed number of steps.
S_i is at most S_j within T steps, with T fixed.
Both of the following hold: A is true at least once within 2 steps, and B is true at every step from step 4 to step 7.
A holds within 2 steps, and B holds at each step from 4 through 7.

At some step within 4 steps, pi_A holds at every step from that step through 4 steps later. From that step through 6 steps later, there is a chosen step at which pi_B holds at every step from that chosen step through 4 steps later.
